scope: Read-only submission-system proof layout review. No manuscript modification, rebuild, model execution or scientific metric recomputation.

endmatter.version_observation: Pages20–21 use the earlier accompanying Supplementary Data and Code archive wording; version alignment is reviewed separately by the parent.

cosmetic_items.description: Table2 mean/interval strings and its header have tight punctuation spacing, e.g. +7.42[2.49,12.48] and difference[95% interval],pp. Values remain readable and unambiguous.
Normal automatic hyphenation/title and email/branch-path line wrapping remain. No content is clipped.
Inline variable notation uses plaintext n_c/rL/rR while the display equations use mathematical subscripts. Optional typographic normalization only.

supplement_delivery_scope: This PDF contains the main manuscript only. Its absence of the six separate supplementary uploads does not establish that the portal omitted them; check the submission file list separately.
